scientific_integrity: The exact finite covariance and its sign classification have an analytic counting proof. Finite exhaustive verification is corroborative, not an infinite proof. No independent audit or validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite G(n,m), n≥h+1, non-induced motifs H of minimum degree at least two. Fixed-motif asymptotics only. A classical factorial-moment identity might imply the result indirectly; historical uniqueness is not independently established.
title: A motif-universal sign transition for leaf covariance in fixed-edge random graphs
